SPADEX: The docking mission has completed its final chapter, per Indian Defence News (about a day ago).
Week in images: Indian Space Hub has a photo roundup for 19 to 23 Oct.
Launch plans: Economic Times says ISRO plans 12 launches this year.

The cyclone forecast stories are from Sept, so they fall outside your dates. I can open any of these for the full story.
